messages:
Diego - Eng Manager: Hi @people-ops, quick Q: Cal moved teams right after completing a stretch assignment and wants that work counted for a mid-cycle promotion. We have evidence but the transfer paperwork shows new manager as of the promotion window. Can the old teams evidence be used?
Maya - People Ops: Short answer: yes if ownership and impact are clear. We need documented sign-off from both old and new managers and a one-paragraph ownership statement.
Cal - IC: To clarify, Im asking to be leveled to L4; most of the work was with Diegos team but my official transfer date was during the window.
Sara - Payroll: Timing note: changes approved before payroll freeze (see intranet) can be effective retroactively to the transfer date. After the freeze, we can still process retros but they hit the next payroll.
Diego - Eng Manager: What exactly goes in the ownership statement? Any template?
Maya - People Ops: Use this minimal template and attach PRs/metrics:
```
- Contributor: Cal
- Project: batching subsystem rewrite
- Dates: 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-12
- Contribution summary: designed and implemented new batching allocator, authored RFC, led rollout for two services
- Impact: 25% p99 latency drop, estimated $12k/mo infra savings
- Ownership: Primary delivery by Diego's team through 3/10, then transitioned to Suarez's team on 3/11. Both managers confirm contributions.
```
Comp Bot: Reminder: leveling-exception form required for cross-org mapping. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/leveling-exception-form
Diego - Eng Manager: If the new manager endorses, do we still need calibration review?
Maya - People Ops: Yes. Any mid-cycle transfer + promotion requires calibration sign-off. Submit the packet and mark "mid-cycle transfer" so chairs flag it.
Cal - IC: If calibration delays the approval past the payroll cutoff, will the effective date be the transfer date or the approval date?
Sara - Payroll: If approvals land after payroll freeze, we'll backdate pay to the transfer date but actual payment arrives in the next payroll run as a retro. We'll include a clear breakdown in the notification email.
Maya - People Ops: For international folks: mention country and employment entity in the packet. Employment Ops may require additional tax/visa checks that can delay effective date.
Diego - Eng Manager: For leveling exceptions where role mapping differs, who signs off on band mapping?
Maya - People Ops: Calibration chairs + compensation team. If it's an exception we escalate to comp for a final sign-off; use the "escalate" checkbox and ping @Maya.
Cal - IC: One last thing  will equity banding change immediately?
Maya - People Ops: Equity grants follow comp approval and have their own timeline. If approved mid-cycle, grant paperwork is issued next equity cycle; well note it in the approval letter.
Comp Bot: Action logged: packet_submitted? false. Calibration meeting: Thu 9am PT. Submit 48h prior for guaranteed review.
Diego - Eng Manager: Thanks all. I'll collect evidence and have both managers sign off today.
Maya - People Ops: Great  ping me once submitted and Ill do a quick pre-check.
Comp Bot: Thread closed (pending submission).
